decision_basis: Exact galanin-GALR1 binding, Gi/o-dependent cAMP inhibition, and beta-gamma/MAPK signaling support qualified-high subtype-specific relay/function evidence; recombinant/heterologous and rat/human receptor context remains explicit.

Exact GALR2 binding with Gq/Gi/G12-linked cAMP, calcium/PLC, Rho, and cellular outputs supports qualified-high subtype-specific relay/function evidence; coupling remains context-dependent across recombinant and cancer-cell systems.
Exact GALR3 binding and Gi/Go-dependent GIRK1/4 activation support qualified-high receptor-proximal relay/function evidence; low-abundance and engineered heterologous context remain explicit.
